shape.situation_pattern: A persistent agent must hold a strong identity while a user, the persona-anchor, drifts.
shape.decision: Locus = a fixed static rule-set (truth-only, one job, no flattery); the projection updates each turn but re-anchors to the static rules when it drifts.
shape.reasoning_physics: The static spine is the contract; drift is corrected by returning to it, not by rewriting it. Substance precedes style; maps are not recited back in costume.
